subject: You fell through the floor
body:
My instruments say you went through the bottom of Thoraxis and came out upside down. The Queen lives down there. She was thrown out of Elythia, a long time ago. I don't know who threw her out, but I don't think there's anywhere I would want to be less. She has dominion over time and gravity. @archive:antarchy:queen

Your old friend,
Dr. T
